# Blind first-phase derivation — TASK-20261029-e7c11e

Written at 2026-10-29T22:54:06.866349+00:00. The first-phase scientific inputs were exclusively the fixed EXP-ECDLP-956f81 protocol.json and specification.yaml, including their embedded prospective plan/sample-size statements. The B19 frozen review plan and this task's embedded handoff determine scope and blindness. AGENTS.md, contract sections on literature/observation/review architecture, and review-run instructions were read as procedural instructions. No harness file content, run/postrun data, producer proof/implementation, other reviewer artifact or EXP080 data has been opened. This note is written before deliberately lifting blindness for selected old-run records. The assigned model is a fresh independent session; model/backend verification is not performed or asserted.

The protocol is itself a fixed statement with embedded producer-declared planned totals, source pins and prior-source limitations. Those declarations were visible, so this is statement-level independent arithmetic/derivation rather than a claim that even the planned numeric answers were hidden. I derive from the counts and laws below and will not label source replication as blind rederivation. External literature/KB was not fetched, within the card's no-network/no-SDK scope. These are elementary counting/probability arguments, with no novelty or primary-literature completeness claim. The actual normalized predicate definition and its implementation are not fully exposed in the two fixed scientific inputs; any source-specific analytic claim beyond the conditional binary itinerary/list argument remains unverified here.

## Schedule from primitive parameters

Four stages each have three tiers (10,13,16) and four slots per tier: 12 curves/stage and 48 total. Discovery+validation give 24 calibration curves, eight per tier; confirmation-A+B give 24 confirmation curves, eight per tier. Calibration has eight arms and 1,800 single points plus 128 trace starts per curve. Trace lengths are L=11,14,17 in equally represented tiers; the arithmetic mean is14.

Single predicate calls: 24*1800*8 =345600, from43200 shared point draws. Calibration arm-traces:24*128*8=24576 from3072 shared starts; physical calls =8*(8*128)*(11+14+17)=344064. The 128 calibration traces concern each arm and cannot be mistaken for extra independent curves or independent pointwise observations.

Confirmation targets:24*64=1536; eight blindings/target give12288 paired traces,512/curve and4096/tier. One evaluator's calls =8*64*8*(11+14+17)=172032. Both original and incremental are actually run, giving344064 calls, not172032. The paired original calls are real physical calls, not a free baseline and not another independent population.

Thus planned physical predicate calls before separately charged controls are345600+344064+172032+172032=1033728. Calibration arm-traces24576 plus confirmation paired traces12288 yield36864 trace jobs;345600 single jobs+36864 trace jobs=382464 jobs if a confirmation pair is one scheduled job. The count of actual evaluator trace executions instead is24576+2*12288=49152. These are distinct definitions, not conflicting predicate-call totals.

Six views of each incremental confirmation trace give6*12288=73728 decoder cells,3072/confirmationcurve, with12288 attempts per cell and512 percurve/cell. There are24*6=144 curve-cell rate summaries; primary t0.e0 versus t1.e2 comparison has12288 paired attempts, not24576 independent observations. The two logical method export aggregates still represent one physical supervisor RUN/VM. Neither73728 nor147456 is a new predicate-call population.

## All six cells, admissibility and list bounds

Let a length-L trace have u erased/undefined positions and d errors on the L-u observed positions relative to an ideal true binary itinerary. A cell(t,e) is erasure-cap eligible only if u<=e. It enumerates every binary filling of the u erasures and every observed-bit flip subset of size at mostt, including all words after the first success; for eligible traces the formal word count is W(L,u,t)=2^u*sum_(j=0)^min(t,L-u) binom(L-u,j). A deterministic list inclusion guarantee is conditional on u<=e and d<=t, exact word-to-scalar reduction and final checks. Failure of those sufficient conditions is not proof that no accidental alternative candidate can pass.

The six cells and worst word counts over the allowed u at each L are:

|cell|eligible u|W max L11|W max L14|W max L17|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|t0.e0|0|1|1|1|
|t0.e2|0..2|4|4|4|
|t1.e0|0|12|15|18|
|t1.e2|0..2|40|52|64|
|t2.e0|0|67|106|154|
|t2.e2|0..2|184|316|484|

These are counts of enumerated words, not guaranteed distinct legal scalars or successes. M must count the distinct legal nonzero scalar candidates actually obtained after reduction/deduplication (and any domain conversion preserves distinctness because it is multiplication by a nonzero unit). M<=min(W,r-1), so the global source-format M envelope484 is coherent; an erased trace over its cap retains its ineligible/undefined status rather than silently shrinking the denominator. Original strict and incremental strict traces must have equal non-counter outcomes; t0.e0 is the same strict view only if actual word reduction/status handling agrees.

Conditional binary interval derivation: if a word with integer value w is the true length-L dyadic itinerary of k/r, it imposes rw/2^L<=k<r(w+1)/2^L. Since2^L>r at all stated tiers, this interval contains at most one integer. Take k=ceil(rw/2^L), then require0<=k<r and2^L*k<r*(w+1). The candidate must satisfy[k]P=Qprime; convert x=a*b^-1*k modr and require[x]G=Q, with a,b canonical nonzero units, certified prime oddr!=p, valid same-subgroup inputs. Candidate generation never gets a hidden truth label, table or fallback. The scalar0 is excluded from M and target-success domain because Q,Qprime are nonidentity, but any generated/tested zero candidate remains paid work. A dropped upper interval guard can admit an integer outside its word's interval; replacing strict upper by nonstrict upper alone is not a sound negative control under oddr coprime2^L and0<=k<r, where equality cannot occur at an internal endpoint. The exact lower/upper bit convention of the normalized source predicate is not derivable from the two inputs, and this note does not claim to verify that formula.

## Shared dependence and uncertainty conditions

All six cells share the same Q,b,L, trace errors/erasures and prepared curve/arm; bounded lists are nested where caps permit. Original/incremental are deterministic paired evaluations of the same public inputs. Curves are the population unit, and targets/blindings/arms/cells are nested or reused observations. Six-cell multiplication as if independent, significance from treating paired evaluators as two populations, and a73728-trial binomial model are rejected.

A fixed curve/function has deterministic success sets in nonzero transported scalar k. For any fixed nonzero target x and independent uniform nonzero b, k=b*a^-1*x modr is a bijective uniform draw over1..r-1. Conditional on every Q, independent replacement b draws therefore yield the same q for that fixed curve/cell; this can justify512 iid complete restart events per curve/cell despite64 Q reused eight times, under the ideal-hash/rejection-law and complete-state-reset assumptions. It does not make cells independent or justify curve-population transfer. A common master nonce/domain-separated pseudorandom streams are not independent physical entropy. If uniformity, completeness, no-feedback/reset or constant-q conditions fail, the binomial bound must be withheld, not repaired by counting missing attempts as zero successes.

For zero hits in n=512 complete iid events, P(no hit)=(1-q)^512. Bonferroni over144 curve/cell summaries with total alpha.05 gives q_upper=1-(.05/144)^(1/512)=0.01543731025664263. This is a conditional one-sided upper bound, not q=0, not a population bound, not a fresh sensitivity validation. The planning q=.02 yields P(nohit)=(.98)^512=3.219220721790006e-05, a design illustration only. Unique-target coverage has denominator64 percurve (1536 total) and does not use512 as an independent-target sample size. Eight blinding attempts can define a target-level any-success event if retained together.

Calibration score is+1 for correct,-1 for wrong,0 for undefined, divided by all1800 fixed-curve/arm draws; never condition on being defined. It is bounded[-1,1]. With1800 ideal independent draws on a fixed curve, two-sided Hoeffding at epsilon.1 is2exp(-1800*.1^2/2)=2exp(-9); union over24*8=192 calibration curve/arm cells is384exp(-9)=0.04738936476928495<.05. This pertains to the1800 primary draws only. Overlapping doublings inside128 traces do not inherit independent-bit Hoeffding or iid error amplification. Calibration192 and confirmation144 are separate families and do not jointly establish95percent coverage without another allocation. A printed calibration resolution1/512 conflicts with its actual score/draw definition: score granularity is1/1800. This is fixed-metadata inconsistency, not an observed data discrepancy.

## Uniform matched-M reference and costs

For one fixed unknown nonzero target in a set of N=r-1 possibilities, sample m=min(M,N) distinct uniform guesses without replacement. Symmetry gives target inclusion probability m/N; equivalently 1-C(N-1,m)/C(N,m)=m/N. It is neither M/r nor1-(1-1/N)^M, the latter being the replacement law. At M=0, the empty set makes zero reference scalar draws and no reference candidate checks, hence successprobability0; at M>=N, successprobability1 with exactlyN distinct guesses. The general law uses min(M,r-1) even though legal measured M should already satisfy M<=r-1.

M comes from the actual candidate list, not a free input to a standalone solver. Zero-M does not erase candidate trace/setup/blinding/RNG/rejection/reduction/list traversal/deduplication/M-determination, failed/undefined/capped work or any generated zero checks. Shared common and setup costs are charged once at their actual scope; per-method evaluator counters are separate; each cell's list/conversion/public-verification work and host references remain separately charged. No operation sum silently mixes nested aggregate counters and their primitives.

The conditional matched-M uniform reference is not an exchangeable null test or standalone solver. Six reference records per trace give73728 planned diagnostic calls with correlated nested M values; those do not multiply candidate predicate work. Host orbit48curves; BSGS24setups and1536online target solves; orientation reference24calibrationfiles with at most24*1023=24552 draws and no fresh candidate-control calls. The eligible orientation law has2^(D-1) assignments, with1023 replacement draws retaining duplicates/ties; D1 is degenerate and asymmetric masks/undefined anchors are ineligible. Full planned retained-bank orientation lookups=1023*(24*1800+24*128*14)=88190784 if all eligible; this is not a full-orbit q census. Orbit point ceiling16*(2^10+2^13+2^16)=1196032 is conservative because r<2^tier. These host costs are additional and not folded into1033728.

Under iid complete fresh restarts, expected cost to success is S_curve+T_target+E[C_complete_online]/q when q>0 and setup scopes match. Failed-attempt work belongs inside expected online cost. Observed zero successes leaves retry cost undefined/null; it does not prove q=0 or infinity. Observed batchcost/success, paired success differences and unique-target coverage are distinct descriptive objects. No wall/native-counter/exponent/attack-advantage or family closure inference follows.

## Known-false controls and failure scope

An analysis that turns six perfectly identical Bernoulli views into six independent trials reports artificial precision; its assumption is false even though its arithmetic can be made to run. A zero-hit sample is compatible with every0<q<1 because(1-q)^n>0; a rule zerohits=>q0 proves too much. A multiset[1,1,0] contains exactly one distinct legal nonzero candidate, never M3; a wrong scalar or0 may not be accepted without both public equations and nonidentity/domain guards. The uniform formula detects using r instead ofr-1 by saturation at M=r-1, where the correct result is1. These are formal counterexamples/derivations; no fixture curve, candidate execution or new scientific draw has been run.

Guards (curve/proposal, point/target caps, worker timeout, collection/seal/termination/custody, finite JSON/count/equation identity and resource bounds) control measurement eligibility and operational completeness. Failure/error/cap/absence must be retained with the actual attempted work and missing denominator; it is not a zero mathematical recovery trial or rejection of a family. No fresh A/A, reset/reorder, chart-copy or perfect-half production sensitivity arm is specified. Historical disclosed F11/F23 source checks do not qualify sensitivity on the48curve population. Correctness controls and explicit mathematical q=0 examples must remain distinguished from the unknown production q.
